description: This file defines a React component 'WorkflowDesigner' that provides a visualization interface for designing workflows using reactflow library. It manages nodes and edges representing steps in a flow chemistry process, with initial hardcoded data, and supports interactive graph modifications.

methods.name: WorkflowDesigner
methods.description: React functional component that renders a flow diagram builder for workflow design.

methods.description: Handles new connections between nodes, adding edges to the current set.
